nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: source_tab: which tab to enrich ("Selected" or "Raw Leads").

parameters.content:
## Fill in the profile columns
Run this **after** the harvest workflow. It reads a tab, finds rows that have a `Profile URL` but no profile data yet, scrapes each profile once, and **updates those rows in place** — it never appends.

**source_tab** — `Selected` (the handful you actually want) or `Raw Leads` (everything).

**only_missing** — `true` skips rows already enriched, so it is safe to re-run after a partial or failed run.

**test_mode** — `true` does only the first `test_limit` rows.

Rows are matched on **OIB**, and only the OIB / Owner-Director / Email / Founding Date / NKD / MBS cells are written. Everything else in the row is left untouched.

A failed profile leaves the row blank rather than half-written, so re-running picks it up again.
